title: Stir-Fried Tofu with Jamaican Jerk Seasoning
description: A Japanese-inspired dish that combines the flavors of the Caribbean with the simplicity of stir-frying. Crispy tofu, savory vegetables, and aromatic herbs come together in this quick and easy recipe.

ingredients.name: Tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into small cubes

ingredients.name: Herbal Oil
ingredients.notes: such as sesame or vegetable oil

ingredients.name: Snow Peas
ingredients.notes: trimmed and cut into bite-sized pieces

instructions: 1. Heat the herbal oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
2. Add the onion and bell pepper and cook until they start to soften, about 3-4 minutes.
3. Add the snow peas and cook until they start to soften, about 2-3 minutes.
4. Add the grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
5. Add the tofu and cook until it is golden brown on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
6. Add the Jamaican Jerk Seasoning and stir to coat the tofu and vegetables.
7. Add the light soy sauce and stir to combine.
8. Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the sauce has thickened.
9. Garnish with green onions and serve hot.
